question: Which company has the best AI model end of September?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the company which owns the model which has the highest arena rank based on the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab is checked on September 30, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Overall" Leaderboard tab at https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control with style control off (Adjustments: None) and filtered for "Models" will be used to resolve this market.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie still remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “SpaceXAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking.

The resolution source for this market is the arena.ai Text Arena (Overall). If this resolution source is unavailable at check time, this market will remain open until the leaderboard comes back online and will resolve based on the first check after it becomes available. If it becomes permanently unavailable, this market will resolve to "Other".

"Other" means any option not listed here.

# Which company will have the top model on Arena's Text leaderboard at the end of September? Research as of 2026-09-09

**Summary:** Every leaderboard snapshot I found from before September 9 shows Anthropic at #1, holding at least the top three places in mid-August. Meta was the closest rival, about 8 points behind. Anthropic released Fable 5.1 on September 1, and it had entered Arena voting but had no score yet. The biggest risk to the leader is Google's Gemini 4, which had no release date. Several sources I found turned out to be dated after 2026-09-09, so I left them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- I fetched arena.ai/leaderboard/text/overall-no-style-control. The live page now shows a leaderboard date after the 2026-09-09 cutoff, so I excluded its contents. I could not find an archived copy of the page from on or before 9 September.
- 2026-08-12: A Manifold market's description quoted the Text Arena (Overall) top four. Anthropic held 1-3: claude-fable-5 (1507±5), claude-opus-4-6-thinking (1505±4) and claude-opus-4-7-thinking (1502±4). Meta's muse-spark-1.2 was #4 at 1499±10. The same description notes the site moved from lmarena.ai to arena.ai. [manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-anthropic-hold-all-3-top-spots)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. The check is on September 30.
- Around 2026-08-21: a comment on the same Manifold market said muse-spark-1.2 had slipped from 1499 to 1498, #3 was at 1502, and no new challenger had entered. Grok-4.6 (SpaceXAI/xAI) was about 40 places down. [manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-anthropic-hold-all-3-top-spots)
- Another undated comment there said Anthropic held ranks 1-4, with muse-spark-1.2 at #5 (1499). [manifold](https://manifold.markets/Terminator2/will-anthropic-hold-all-3-top-spots)
- In short, from all the evidence before September 9, Anthropic led by a few points, and Meta was the nearest other company.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-02: Techmeme pages from that date surfaced in a search about Muse Spark 1.3 and Gemini 3.8 Flash, but the site blocked access, so I couldn't confirm what they say. I found no evidence of either model on the Text Arena before September 9. [techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/260902/p46)
- 2026-09-01: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.1, and Mythos 5.1 for vetted organizations only. Fable 5.1 is billed as its most capable public model and costs about 25% less than Fable 5. [mezha](https://mezha.ua/news/anthropic-claude-fable-5-1-314761/), [tecnoblog](https://tecnoblog.net/noticias/anthropic-lanca-fable-5-1-com-menos-restricoes-e-promessa-de-economia/)
- Around 2026-09-01: Arena said Fable 5.1 had entered voting with scores still to come. This comes from a repost; the original page returned an error when I tried it. [traeai](https://www.traeai.com/articles/28bbce6c-0510-4498-a184-913120394c77)
- 2026-07-21: A Google blog post reportedly confirmed that Gemini 4 pre-training had started. This is second-hand, from an article summary. [emergent](https://emergent.sh/news/gemini-4-release-date)
- 2026-06-09: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5. [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/polymarket-anthropic-mythos-model-september-odds/)

## 4. Base rates
- Anthropic has been #1 continuously since at least early July:
  - 2026-07-01: claude-fable-5 #1 at 1509. [toolcenter](https://www.toolcenter.ai/en/llm-leaderboard)
  - August 2026: Fable 5 still first, with Gemini 3.7 Flash the best Google model at about #9. [blogdumoderateur](https://www.blogdumoderateur.com/top-20-modeles-ia-performants-aout-2026/)
  - 2026-08-12: Anthropic held the top three (section 1).
- Scores moved by only about 1-2 points over 2-3 weeks in August. The lead over Meta (about 8 points) is roughly the size of a new model's ±7-10 confidence interval.
- In past cycles, the #1 spot usually changed hands when a lab released a new flagship model, not because existing models drifted.

## 5. Other forecasts
- An undated Polymarket mirror of this exact market (created 2026-07-17) shows Anthropic at 85% and about $68.5K in volume. [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/market/which-company-has-the-best-ai-model-end-of-september-20260717143435868/)
- DeFi Rate says Anthropic is above 99% for #1 at the end of September; the snapshot date is unclear. [defirate](https://defirate.com/prediction-markets/best-ai-model-odds-this-year/)
- For the separate Polymarket year-end (2026) market, DeFi Rate shows Anthropic between 53% and 74% depending on the page and date. [defirate](https://defirate.com/odds/best-ai-model-2026/)
- An undated article reports Polymarket at 74% that Anthropic releases a new Mythos-class model by September 9, rising to 87% by month-end. [cryptobriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/polymarket-anthropic-mythos-model-september-odds/)
- I couldn't confirm a live Polymarket price dated on or before September 9. It's worth checking Polymarket directly.

## 6. Upcoming events before September 30
- **Fable 5.1 score:** its first Text Arena score could add to Anthropic's lead.
- **Gemini 4:** no release date was announced before September 9. It is Google's main chance to take #1; Google's current best, the Flash models, sit well behind.
- **Meta:** Muse Spark 1.3 and any later Meta release could close the roughly 8-point gap if they join the leaderboard.
- **OpenAI:** GPT-5.6 Sol existed, but I found no pre-September 9 evidence of it near the top of the Text Arena. I found nothing on a pending OpenAI flagship release.
- **Others:** I found no evidence that DeepSeek, Alibaba or SpaceXAI models were near the top before September 9.
- **Preliminary scores:** a new model's preliminary score can debut high and then settle as votes accumulate.
